central_question: whether stimulus-locked response strength and within-recording reliability explain concurrent cognitive performance or improve held-out individual prediction

dryad_spatial_robustness.roi_estimand: participant-level (theta-plus minus non-rhythmic) contrast in primary ROI minus the same contrast in anatomical control ROI
dryad_spatial_robustness.channel_estimand: participant-level theta-plus minus non-rhythmic contrast at each frozen-QC good scalp channel

channel_inference.multiplicity: maximum absolute cluster mass separately recomputed for every permutation

prohibitions: no channel, ROI, time-window, or frequency selection after viewing spatial effects
no replacement of the original frozen primary ITPC estimand
no entrainment-mechanism claim from spatial localization

rules: report the original estimate and confidence interval before any threshold interpretation
do not convert failure to reject into evidence of absence
Dryad coupling is classified as unresolved when intervals include effects of practical importance
ds006780 d-prime validity is not called equivalent when the interval exceeds the declared bound
all smallest-effect thresholds must be justified independently of observed estimates

constraints: preserve original outcomes, feature sets, and outer splits
all tuning remains inside training data
no model shopping based on performance
prediction cannot rescue an unsupported mechanistic claim

prohibited_extensions: pooling raw effects across heterogeneous datasets
